title: feat(plugin-auth): an SSO provider can sign the person out of the company sign-in too, per provider and off by default
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoXWz3QUTxJUCojqnWZbH75T)_

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

Part of #32087

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：每个 SSO 提供方新增「退出时同时退出公司登录」开关（默认关闭，改动进审计）。开启后，退出平台也会结束身份提供方的会话：SAML 走单点登出，OIDC 走带 id_token_hint 的登出跳转。
- 为什么改：#32087 第 4 项，Tesla 选 A（裁定 6866334319）：企业可以按提供方要求「退出平台即退出公司登录」。
- 风险与回滚：开关默认关闭，现有提供方的退出行为不变；SAML 登出端点只在开关开启时打开，且只接受已签名的登出消息。回滚即还原本 PR，新增列默认值为 false。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-sign-out-of-idp.ts`（退出流程与保存时的能力判定），以及 `sso-sign-in-options.ts` 里按提供方生效的 SAML 选项。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sso-sign-out-of-idp.test.ts src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts src/sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts src/sso-provider-lifecycle.test.ts -t "sign out of the company sign-in too|single logout|logout redirect|can honour it"`
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A new per-provider sign-in option, **Sign Out of the Company Sign-In Too** (`sys_sso_provider.sign_out_of_idp`, boolean, default false, `trackHistory`). It is declared to `@better-auth/sso` as a provider additional field, so the vendor's own `/sso/register` and `/sso/update-provider` take it as `signOutOfIdp`, with the same writers as the other sign-in options. Edit Sign-In Options gains its param, and the provider list shows the column.

With the switch on, `POST /sign-out` also ends the identity provider's session, and answers better-auth's own `{ success, url, redirect }` shape (a `Location` header unless `disableRedirect`):

- **SAML single logout.** The vendor's `enableSingleLogout` is read per provider: `ssoSamlOptions()` answers it from a request scope holding the provider's column, so the ACS records the SAML session, the SP metadata advertises SingleLogoutService, and `/sso/saml2/sp/slo/:providerId` opens, only while the switch is on. `wantLogoutRequestSigned` and `wantLogoutResponseSigned` are always true. Sign-out runs the vendor's own SP-initiated `/sso/saml2/logout/:providerId` and answers its logout URL. The identity provider's logout address is the new optional **IdP Logout URL** (`logoutUrl`) on Register SAML Provider and Edit SAML Settings, stored as the vendor's `idpMetadata.singleLogoutService` (one address under the HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST bindings; no new column). A sign-out through that path writes the same logout audit row as `/sign-out`.
- **OIDC RP-initiated logout.** The sign-in at a provider whose switch is on records the session's provider. Sign-out runs the platform's own sign-out unchanged, then answers the provider's `end_session_endpoint` with `id_token_hint` (the ID token of that sign-in), `client_id`, `post_logout_redirect_uri` (only for a `callbackURL` on a trusted origin) and `state`. The endpoint is read from the provider's discovery document when the switch is saved on, and kept in its stored `oidc_config` as `endSessionEndpoint`.

Saving the switch on is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` on `signOutOfIdp` for a provider that cannot honour it: SAML with no logout address; OIDC whose discovery document cannot be read, names no `end_session_endpoint`, or names one off the trusted origins. Saving it off is never refused.

## Tests

- `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`, "sign out of the company sign-in too: SAML single logout", against the real vendor and a `samlify` identity provider:
  - CONTROL, switch off: the identity provider's signed LogoutRequest is refused `SINGLE_LOGOUT_NOT_ENABLED` and the session stands; sign-out answers no `url`.
  - On: sign-out answers the IdP logout URL with a LogoutRequest for that person, and the session ends.
  - On: an unsigned LogoutRequest and an unsigned LogoutResponse are each refused; the signed LogoutResponse lands.
  - On: a signed message in the HTTP-Redirect binding is refused (fail closed).
  - On: a signed LogoutRequest naming one person ends that person's session only, and answers the identity provider.
  - The SP metadata advertises SingleLogoutService only while the switch is on.
- `sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts`, "sign out of the company sign-in too: OIDC logout redirect": CONTROL off (no `url`, nothing recorded); on (the `url` is the `end_session_endpoint` with `id_token_hint` equal to the signed-in ID token, `client_id`, `post_logout_redirect_uri`, `state`, `Location` set, the session ends); an untrusted `callbackURL` is not passed on.
- `sso-provider-lifecycle.test.ts`, "saved on only for a provider that can honour it": the refusals through `/sso/update-provider` for SAML and OIDC with the switch left off, saving off never refused, the IdP Logout URL through the edit and register doors, and the OIDC endpoint kept on a save that lands.
- `sso-sign-out-of-idp.test.ts`: the capability judge, the IdP Logout URL mapping, the single-logout paths and the OIDC logout URL, read off their own inputs.
- `sso-sign-in-options.test.ts`: the per-provider `enableSingleLogout` scope and the always-signed logout flags. `auth-session-audit.test.ts`: the SAML logout path writes a logout row.

Ablation: `wantLogoutRequestSigned` / `wantLogoutResponseSigned` set to false in `ssoSamlOptions()` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0 on disk): the unsigned-message pin and the redirect-binding pin go red; restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty, green again.

## Acceptance notes

Remainders, not in this PR:

- The Console: the sign-out following the answered `url`, and any Edit Sign-In Options / SAML form item the form does not render by itself (a later ui card).

Measured on `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12 and noted for the reviewer:

- The vendor verifies no HTTP-Redirect binding signature on an incoming logout message, so a signed redirect-binding message is refused; identity providers must send logout messages in the HTTP-POST binding.
- The vendor's outgoing LogoutRequest carries no RelayState, so after the identity provider's logout the person lands on the app's root, and the LogoutRequest is signed only when the provider's SAML configuration asks for it.
- Only sessions started while the switch is on are covered; an older session signs out of the platform only.
- The shared OIDC callback without a provider id is not recorded (no provider here sets a `redirectURI`).
- A logout the identity provider starts ends the platform session but is not written as a logout audit row.

## Verification

- The four test files above, and the full suites: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` 267 files / 5072 tests and `@objectstack/platform-objects` 121 files / 1955 tests, all green.
- `tsc --noEmit` for both packages; the translation bundles regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`.
- Every gate `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives (77), each run with its exit code recorded, reconciled with `--ran`: 77 run, 0 not measured, all exit 0. ESLint on the changed files is clean.
